decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment is far from the maritime core and showed no visible traction in 2024, but it runs on existing crewing infrastructure at low cost, so the firm will likely tolerate it for another year.
Superyacht crew recruitment is a natural, low-cost extension of the firm's crewing network and seafarer pool.
The BSM Smart Academy is growing its partner network quickly and supports the firm's core training and crewing strategy.
FuelEU Maritime monitoring is a mandatory regulatory need for clients, and the firm has already delivered on its deadlines.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the PAL software and supports the firm's digitalisation and environmental-performance direction.
The cost simulator is integrated into PAL and helps clients plan compliance costs, though it could later be merged into the dashboard.
